gen-gf-baumans-gf-sarala: A c flung wide and strokes of one thickness give Baumans a commanding, distinctive look. Sarala is the approachable one, with clearly separated gaps and a thickness like neon glass tubing.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-shippori-antique: Glass-tube lettering with a commanding streak, Baumans holds every stroke to one thickness. And it does its best work big and brief, while Shippori Antique gives it a monoweight, contemporary partner with open bowls.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-snippet: Baumans is commanding and distinctive, holding every stroke to one thickness with a wide-mouthed c. And Snippet bends its letters like wire, friendly and approachable, leaving Baumans the big, short lines.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-source-sans-3: Tubular and cocksure, Baumans holds a single stroke weight from first letter to last. Source Sans 3 is modern, its a breathing open at the lower bowl, and it likes a size well below the heading.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-stick: Commanding up top, Baumans keeps every stroke to one thickness. Stick brings tubelike, constant-weight lines with exits wide enough to pass light, and the shared uniform stroke is what ties the two.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-suse: Up top, a flung-wide c and strokes held to one thickness give Baumans an unmistakably commanding, distinctive personality. SUSE feels softer beside it, with rope-round curves and open bowls, approachable.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-tajawal: Baumans is commanding, with round bowls whose outlines never swell or thin. Tajawal brings a broad, hook-shaped c and a cleaner, quieter voice, and that gap in temperament is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-tasa-explorer: Glass tubing bent into letters: that is Baumans, all one thickness. TASA Explorer is the clean, approachable side, its curves ending like brush strokes lifted early, and that softer touch against rigid tubing is the draw.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-tasa-orbiter: Cable bent into shapes, Baumans never swells or thins a stroke. TASA Orbiter keeps every small counter unclogged, which means you can size the body text down without it turning muddy.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-teachers: Teachers is a modern sans bent from thin steel rod, its ink strokes tapering out before they touch. And Baumans takes the loud, commanding part, every stroke held to one thickness against that delicate line.
